message.author: Avery Calder
message.body: Kickoff is complete. Please keep the finance/value workstream evidence-led and separate validated facts from working assumptions.

replies.reply: Draft will use revenue quality, cost discipline, and cash confidence as the three branches.
Portfolio page is ready for a short internal status once the baseline is confirmed.

message.author: Theo Mercer
message.body: The workshop surfaced a ¥42.8M working estimate. It remains a hypothesis pending evidence review.

replies.reply: Please label the number as working estimate in every portfolio reference.

message.author: Keiko Ward
message.body: Observation plan is approved: marked routes, required PPE, no individual performance assessment, and no identifiable images.

replies.reply: Confirmed. The walk will focus on process conditions rather than people.

message.author: Theo Mercer
message.body: Several recurring handoffs merit validation against volume and timing data. No safety exceptions were observed.

actions.action: Check volume context before estimating impact

replies.reply: I will pair the observation log with available aggregate measures only.
Keep the synthesis specific about what is observed versus inferred.

message.author: Avery Calder
message.body: For this week's review, link Client Alpha Phase 1 and Client Beta Phase 2 as complementary evidence streams, not a combined value claim.

replies.reply: Confirmed. Alpha retains the ¥42.8M working-estimate label; Beta remains observation-led.
